contradictions.title: sprint-closeout.json overclaims 51/51 COMPLETE; bundle contains 47/51 COMPLETE
contradictions.claim: sprint-closeout.json (disk, post-freeze): taskcards.total=51, complete=51, pending=0, verdict=SPRINT_COMPLETE
contradictions.reality: Bundle taskcards.json: total=51, COMPLETE=47, PENDING=4 (W17-L0-05, L0-06, L0-07, LG-05)
contradictions.root_cause: sprint-closeout.json was written after bundle freeze with updated task counts, but bundle was not rebuilt to include it
contradictions.repair_action: W18 writes closeout-addendum classifying W17 correctly; W18 protocol freezes bundle BEFORE writing final closeout

contradictions.title: No sprint-closeout.json or final-attestation.json inside bundle
contradictions.reality: Neither sprint-closeout.json nor final-attestation.json appears in the 59-entry bundle
contradictions.root_cause: These files were created after bundle freeze and never re-bundled
contradictions.repair_action: W18 includes these files inside the bundle (or their W18 equivalents)

contradictions.title: pclc_total=22 but only 20 PR packets in bundle
contradictions.reality: publication/unified-20-pclc-readiness-v2.json has 20 packages; threed/convert-3d-model and font/convert-font have no PR packets
contradictions.root_cause: PR packets for the 2 new W17 packages were not created before bundle freeze
contradictions.repair_action: W18 Lane B creates PR packets for threed/convert-3d-model and font/convert-font; W18 readiness file covers all 22+

contradictions.title: External .sha256 sidecar exists on disk but was not verified by reviewer
contradictions.claim: W17 sprint claimed sidecar written at .local/evidence-bundles/lowcode-plugin-canonical-package-wave17-20260606.sha256
contradictions.reality: Sidecar exists on disk (correct per v2 protocol — external to bundle), but reviewer could not confirm upload
contradictions.root_cause: v2 protocol correctly places sidecar external to ZIP; reviewer only had ZIP upload
contradictions.repair_action: W18 re-verifies W17 sidecar SHA on disk; W18 sidecar is confirmed by automated post-freeze verification

contradictions.title: W17 disk taskcards.json shows 51/51 COMPLETE but bundle shows 47/51
contradictions.root_cause: 4 closing taskcards were marked COMPLETE on disk after bundle freeze
contradictions.repair_action: W18 pre-bundle-closeout honestly documents N-4 complete before freeze; all 4 close as part of bundle closure
